divergences.upstreamResult: Interaction callbacks receive React synthetic events.
divergences.octaneResult: Interaction callbacks receive native DOM events through Octane's delegated event system.
divergences.rationale: Octane uses native delegated events and does not ship a synthetic event layer.
divergences.consumerImpact: Handlers observe native event shapes (no React SyntheticEvent wrapper) while public Visx callback contracts stay the same.
divergences.migrationGuidance: Read native event fields directly; do not rely on SyntheticEvent helpers such as nativeEvent indirection.
divergences.reviewCondition: Review if Octane adds a React-compatible synthetic event layer.

divergences.upstreamResult: Several Visx controllers are React class components and Brush exposes a legacy class-instance innerRef handle.
divergences.octaneResult: Controllers are native functional TSRX hooks, and Brush intentionally omits upstream's legacy innerRef instance handle.
divergences.rationale: Octane has no class components and uses refs-as-props rather than class-instance handles.
divergences.consumerImpact: Code that inspects Brush via innerRef class methods must use the public callback/props surface instead.
divergences.migrationGuidance: Drop Brush innerRef usage and drive brush state through the documented Visx props and callbacks.
divergences.reviewCondition: Review if Octane adds class-component or class-instance ref compatibility.

divergences.upstreamResult: Text metrics, annotation bounds, SplitLinePath sampling, and wordcloud packing depend on browser measurement/canvas paths.
divergences.octaneResult: Deterministic text metrics and annotation bounds, pure SplitLinePath SVG sampling, and collision-aware estimated wordcloud rectangles replace browser-only measurement/canvas paths.
divergences.rationale: Fixed-size SSR and first hydration must match without browser layout or canvas measurement.
divergences.consumerImpact: Font-specific wrapping, browser-specific path length rounding, and pixel-exact d3-cloud packing can differ from React Visx in the browser.
divergences.migrationGuidance: Treat fixed-size SSR/hydration snapshots as the contract; do not assert browser-specific glyph packing pixels.
divergences.reviewCondition: Review if Octane gains browser-faithful measurement APIs suitable for SSR parity.

divergences.upstreamResult: react-spring uses spring-physics timing and Zoom uses @use-gesture/react listeners.
divergences.octaneResult: react-spring uses a deterministic requestAnimationFrame numeric interpolator, and Zoom uses native wheel/pointer/touch listeners rather than @use-gesture/react at runtime.
divergences.rationale: Octane avoids React-only spring/gesture runtimes while preserving public Visx props and exports; Zoom imports framework-neutral @use-gesture/core types only.
divergences.consumerImpact: Animation timing and gesture delivery can differ from React Visx even when props and exported APIs match.
divergences.migrationGuidance: Assert final animated/gesture state rather than spring-physics frame timing or @use-gesture/react internals.
divergences.reviewCondition: Review if Octane ports react-spring/@use-gesture/react with matching runtime semantics.

divergences.upstreamResult: Child and render-prop positions are typed as React.ReactNode.
divergences.octaneResult: Those positions accept Octane renderables (OctaneNode = unknown); render-prop parameters are unchanged and return Octane renderables.
divergences.rationale: Octane elements are nominal, so ReactNode-typed props would reject them.
divergences.consumerImpact: TypeScript consumers must use Octane renderable types rather than React.ReactNode for Visx children/render props.
divergences.migrationGuidance: Replace React.ReactNode annotations with OctaneNode/unknown at Visx child and render-prop sites.
divergences.reviewCondition: Review if Octane exposes a ReactNode-compatible public renderable alias.
